# Cannot calculate: country of production is missing

The ruleset sets default SEE values by both **CN code and country of production**, and it says not to estimate when a required input is missing. The country field on the form is blank, so I can't select a factor or report a total.

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| CN code | 7201 (Pig iron) | ✅ In table |
| Quantity | 1,500 t | ✅ Provided |
| Country of production | *(blank)* | ❌ **Missing** |

The production route (blast furnace) and installation (Works 2) don't affect the calculation, because default values depend only on CN code and country.

## What's needed

Please confirm the **country of production** for the pig iron from Works 2. The table has CN 7201 factors for these countries:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO₂e/t) | Result for 1,500 t (tCO₂e) |
|---|---|---|
| Türkiye | 1.85 | 2,775.00 |
| China | 1.66 | 2,490.00 |
| India | 2.53 | 3,795.00 |

These are lookups for reference only, not an estimate. The figures differ by up to about 1,305 tCO₂e, so the declared total can't be reported until the country is confirmed.

If the country is not Türkiye, China or India, this table has no default value for it, and a factor would need to come from an approved source outside this ruleset.
